confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderate-confidence; accommodation and drinks are least certain, and Turkish lira volatility makes USD levels hard to pin down for July 2026 peak season. Beer and cocktail are estimated from typical tourist-area pricing. FX value taken from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates page, not read directly; the 2026-10-16 figure from a third-party site was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Turkish Aegean and Mediterranean resort towns with similar July tourism demand, such as Marmaris, Bodrum, and Kaş, adjusted for Fethiye's lower restaurant and guesthouse prices. Turkey straddles Europe and Asia; Europe is used here because the tourist price basis is Mediterranean resort pricing.
